user.title: PV Sunshine
user.description: Turn local PV production into sunlight estimates for automations. Configure Home Assistant location accurately first.

plane.title: PV plane
plane.description: Use a separate production sensor for each plane. Never combine a total sensor with its component strings. Azimuth: north 0°, east 90°, south 180°, west 270°.

data.name: Plane name
data.entity_id: PV production power sensor (W or kW)

weather.title: Enrich existing weather with local sunshine
weather.description: Optional: enrich an existing weather entity with local PV sunshine. Leave the weather entity empty and submit to use PV sensors only. You can change this later in Configure → Weather enrichment. An optional binary sensor blocks PV overrides when on or unavailable (for example inverter curtailment).

error.invalid_weather_source: Select an existing entity of the requested type. PV Sunshine outputs cannot be used as inputs.
